was: Pond Eddy, on the Delaware River. Riverfront full-hookup RV sites up to 50' (20/30/50A W/S/E), bookable via Campspot; on-site restaurant, rafting/tubing, ~70 acres. RV Life $$/5*. --Claude
note: Resort on 70 acres at Pond Eddy, on Route 97 16 miles north of Port Jervis, with nearly a mile of Delaware River frontage: year-round full-hookup RV sites (20/30/50 amp) overlooking the river, riverside, brookside and woods tent sites, cabins and a tiny home, and 2 miles of hiking trails.  It runs half- and full-day rafting, canoeing and tubing trips and has an on-site restaurant with an outdoor bar. --Claude

was: County fairgrounds RV camping in gravel lots on the grounds: 20 full-hookup (50/30A water/sewer/electric), 86 water+electric, and 290 electric-only sites. Big-rig friendly (rigs to ~60 ft; easily fits a 23-ft rig). Open seasonally Apr 15-Oct 15; closed during major fairground events/fair week. Reservable online via Campspot or by phone, not FCFS. RV stays capped at 3 weeks. Free dump station (donations accepted), shower house/restrooms. --Claude
note: Adams County Fairgrounds camping at 947 South Baltimore, Hastings, with 396 hookup sites: 20 back-in full-service sites south of the grandstands (upgraded to 50/30 amp in 2021), 86 water-and-electric and 290 electric-only, plus a tent field, a shower house and a dump station at the entrance that takes free-will donations.  The campground is seasonal, opening and closing with the weather, and closes to the public during several fairground events.  RV stays are limited to three weeks and tent stays to one, and campfires aren't allowed. --Claude

was: City of Scottsbluff park campground in Riverside Park (by the Riverside Discovery Center zoo), with Scotts Bluff National Monument views. 43 pull-through RV sites (vehicles up to 50 ft) plus 20 tent sites; full-hookup, water/electric, or primitive, with 30 and 50 amp service. Dump station, bathhouse with showers, free WiFi, fire ring + picnic table per site. Open seasonally (roughly May 1-Sept 30). Reservable online via Campspot; 14-day RV limit (7-day tents). FHU ~$25/night. RV Life 3.5 stars, $$. Pads sit well back from the North Platte River with open ground, an internal road, and a treeline buffer between sites and the river. --Claude
note: City of Scottsbluff campground in Riverside Park, with views of Scotts Bluff National Monument: 43 pull-through RV sites, full-hookup or water-and-electric, and 20 tent sites, each with a fire ring and picnic table, plus free Wi-Fi and a bathhouse.  The park has playgrounds, disc golf, a dog park, fishing ponds and the Riverside Discovery Center zoo.  It is open all year, though the bathrooms and showers close in the off-season; RV stays are limited to 14 days and tent stays to 7, and golf carts and UTVs aren't allowed.  The pads sit well back from the North Platte River, behind open ground, an internal road and a treeline. --Claude

was: City of Fayette park on an island formed by the Volga River; drive-in via bridge (not boat-in). ~30 sites with electric (110V, 30 & 50 amp) plus water hookups; big-rig friendly open grassy loops fit a 23-ft rig. Modern restroom/shower house (water on Apr-Oct), $2 dump station, 14-day stay limit. Reservable online (parkwith.us/Campspot); ~$25/night RV per city page. Volga River is paddling/tubing access only - camping loops sit back from the water behind a treeline, not riverfront. --Claude
note: City of Fayette park and campground on an island formed by the Volga River, reached by a bridge, with RV sites (30- and 50-amp electric and water) on open grassy loops, tent sites, a playground, three large picnic shelters and easy river access for kayaking, canoeing and tubing; the camping loops sit back from the water behind a treeline.  The modern restrooms and showers are typically open from April through October, and the dump station costs $2.  Campers register and pay by QR code within an hour of arrival, stays are limited to 14 consecutive days, quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m., and check-out is at 4 p.m. --Claude

facilities.note: Restrooms and showers are typically open from April through October.
